# Everett Cento
> AI consultant based in Portland, Oregon, building custom AI for small businesses and solopreneurs, one-on-one. Sometimes he builds the system for you, sometimes he teaches you to build it. Either way you own it.

## What he does
- Custom AI and workflow automation fit to how your business already runs
- One-on-one, no agency handoffs, no templated build
- Based in Portland, Oregon; serves the Pacific Northwest and remote clients across the US
- Building custom AI for small businesses since 2025

## Proof
- Automated content pipeline: raw podcast episode to five publish-ready assets in about 10 minutes instead of about 3 hours
- Personal AI assistant that handles research, file lookups, and task creation from one chat
- Custom dashboards and workflow automations tied to the tools a business already uses
